property_id.description: Numeric GA4 property ID (the Admin UI's 'Property ID', e.g. 313459823). The snapshot's source_properties.property_id carries the API's resource name form (properties/313459823).

credentials_file.description: Path to a service-account JSON key file with read access to the property. A reference only - key material never lives in config files.

credentials_env.description: Name of an environment variable holding the service-account key JSON (the content, not a path). Same indirection pattern as the postgres connector's dsn_env.
